objective: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

description: Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students.  If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!
Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.
progress: You look like you have somewhere to go. Need one of my gryphons?
completion: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh? That won't be a problem. As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
